A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, five figures, Table 1, and appendices A–F support reliable comparison despite formatting and pagination changes.

before.justification: v2 reports original spherical-harmonic regression simulations, attention–kernel correlations, generalization-error experiments, and GPT-2 attention analyses in Sections 4–5 and Appendix F.

after.justification: v3 retains these original simulations and attention analyses, including Table 1 and Figures 1–5.

M1.justification: The five-block transformer construction, Gaussian kernel estimator, training objective, and inference procedure are retained. Query/key notation and decoder explanations are clarified without changing the construction already documented in v2.

E1.justification: Both versions use regression on S² with combinations of ten spherical harmonics and the same five sentences for GPT-2 attention analysis. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The comparisons between learned attention and the Gaussian kernel remain unchanged. Newly cited methods are discussed as related work, without being added to the experimental comparisons.

E3.justification: Sections 4–5 and Appendix F retain the same prompt-length and task-count grids, evaluation metrics, model configurations, data generation, and training procedures.

E4.justification: The attention-correlation analyses, sensitivity to prompt length and training-task count, GPT-2 sentence examples, and additional examples in Figure 5 are retained without new ablations or robustness analyses.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same standard deviations and p-values in Table 1, averaging over 5,000 independent testing samples, and 30 repetitions for Figure 4. No uncertainty-reporting practice or run count changes.

E6.justification: Table 1 retains correlation means of 0.86, 0.75, 0.69, and 0.67, with identical standard deviations and p-values. All plotted results in Figures 1–5 also match, including the appendix examples.

T1.justification: Equations (2) and (15) and Proposition 1 change the logarithmic exponent from 1+3d/4 to 1+3d/2, correcting the squaring step in Appendix E.4. v3 also changes C1's stated dependence to absolute constants and corrects local matrix dimensions and inequalities. The assumptions, leading power-law rates, and proof framework remain intact.

C1.justification: The explicit generalization guarantee presented as a main contribution in Equation (2) becomes weaker through its larger logarithmic factor. The central claims of exact kernel implementation, task generalization, and minimax performance up to logarithmic factors are retained.

C2.justification: v3 explicitly states that the theorem's constants may be nonoptimal and that C2 can depend on d^(d/2). Related qualifications are added to Lemmas 2–3, making limitations of the dimension dependence clearer. The existing fixed-prompt, noiseless-data, and broader-function-class limitations remain.

D1.justification: Appendix F retains the implementation settings, input construction, and exact sentences. Both versions identify supplementary material as the location of implementation code; the rephrased reproducibility statement does not document a different access route.

R1.justification: v3 adds brief operator-learning positioning and citations including Chiu et al. (2025), Cole et al. (2026), and Hsu et al. (2026). Song et al. (2021) replaces Wright and Gonzalez (2021), and Tang et al. (2024) is added for kernel-estimation context. The central comparison with Kim et al. (2024) remains.

P1.justification: A new main-text Section 6 summarizes proof material already present in Appendix C. v3 also formalizes existing manifold and feed-forward-network descriptions and makes localized explanatory edits. Most prose and the overall narrative are retained.

P2.justification: The ICLR format changes the title and author block, running headers, heading typography, and placement of content across pages. The five figures and Table 1 retain their visual content and structure.

improvement.justification: Correcting the missing squaring of the logarithmic factor in Appendix E.4 improves consistency between Lemma 3, Proposition 1, and Theorem 1. Although the resulting bound is weaker, it better reflects the derivation. Explicit qualifications on constants and the main-text proof roadmap improve precision and accessibility, while the method and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
